Political tensions are rising from Bihar to Punjab as the BJP’s Operation Lotus takes a new turn. While Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary is busy managing differences with JD(U) leaders after the controversy surrounding the induction of two MLCs, the BJP has reportedly launched a major political operation in Punjab.
In Punjab, three Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) MLAs have switched sides and joined the BJP ahead of the 2027 Assembly Elections. Raghav Chadha and Sandeep Pathak are reportedly playing a key role in the BJP's political strategy.
